post.summary: Set the saved lending limit (REST route)
post.description: Bound to operation lending.set_owner_settings. Save the most one lent Claude job may spend, in list-price USD. Small limits are allowed; the response names the models that fit and the minimum for the default model. lending.owner_settings reports the engine minimum for each lendable Claude model.
